summary: PAY-UPFRONT flow verified end-to-end via Playwright. Dentist login → New Order build (existing patient, 1 product, 1 tier, 2 FDI teeth 11/12) → submit button reads 'Pay & Place Order · ₹1,171.80' → in MOCK mode the frontend auto-finalizes (POST /orders/checkout then POST /orders with mock razorpay_* fields) → success toast 'Payment successful · Order SDL-... placed!' → nav to order detail (SDL-2026-0008). On the created order: green 'Paid' badge visible next to status; Price Breakup shows Subtotal / Offer Discount / GST / Total / Paid (no 'Pending' row); no Pay / Pay now button on dentist view. Dentist Dashboard has no 'Pending Payment' StatCard. Dentist Invoices table headers = ['INVOICE NO','ORDER','DATE','TOTAL','ACTION'] (no Pending column, no Partially Paid badge). Admin Dashboard has no 'Pending Payments' card. Admin order detail shows Manage/Invoice/Dispatch blocks and does NOT show 'Send Payment Request' or 'Set Paid' controls. All 9 requested verifications PASS.

issues: A 'Pending' StatCard (testid='stat-pending') still exists – verified as Pending ORDER count (not pending payment), so it's compliant with the spec but the label could be made more explicit (e.g. 'Pending Orders') to avoid any confusion now that payment-pending is gone.
'Pending Acceptance' StatCard remains (orders pending acceptance) – also compliant; label refers to order status not payment.

critical_code_review_comments: NewOrder.submit() calls POST /orders/checkout, then in mock mode (chk.mock===true) calls finalizeOrder() with razorpay_signature='mock' — matches backend's 402-on-missing-payment contract.
OrderDetail no longer renders a PayButton for dentists and no PaymentBlock (Send Payment Request / Set Paid) for admins. Confirmed by code inspection and live UI.
Price Breakup intentionally hides Paid row when total==0 OR status==='Free Remake' — good (free remake path will still skip the Paid line, no Pending shown).
Paid pill in OrderDetail header uses dual guard: (amounts.status==='Paid' OR amounts.paid>=amounts.total) AND amounts.total>0 — robust against missing status field.
Invoices.jsx columns reduced to {Invoice No, Order, Date, Total, Action} — matches spec.
DentistDashboard removed payment StatCard but the remaining 'Pending' card still uses generic label — minor wording polish opportunity (non-blocking).
